references.text: Stephen quotes this event in his speech and mentions that another king who did not know Joseph arose in Egypt
Joseph was elevated to the second-highest position in Egypt under Pharaoh, a role the new king chose to ignore
Joseph's death in Egypt marks the end of an era and explains why a new generation of Egyptian leaders did not know him
The Preacher describes how earlier generations are forgotten, reflecting how Joseph was forgotten by the new king
The theme that the wise and their deeds are forgotten by coming generations
Thematic contrast: While the king forgot Joseph (Exodus), Joseph knew his brothers (Genesis), underscoring God's faithfulness despite human forgetfulness.
